status: exploratory feasibility, old training OOF frontiers inspected before implementation, no claim of public preregistration
question: Can a risk score at level9 reduce complete inference cost while preserving verified resolution, outperforming fixed continuation and a competitive observable policy?
scope: stage1 feasibility only; independent evaluation allowed only after positive gate, sample-size design and frozen policy/comparators
engine: prefix-only cached first9 stages; retained states pooled into batches8 for stages10..12; pad only final remainder to batch8; prefix KV sliced by example and concatenated; no input/ref/public-weight changes
controls: scripted keep-none and alternate retention for technical parity
random retention count matched to codes_hidden development-selected policy, fixed seed, independent of labels

features.codes: puzzle onehot and clue counts plus each level1..9 code entropy/margin/max/log-argmax mean/std/q10/q50/q90
features.hidden: 16 PCs of mean/std of generator blocks[7] output at level9, before final norm
features.summary_archived: existing 1341 observable-summary features and immutable outer-fold classifiers, decoder history1..9 computed online and timed

fitting.crossfit: 5 original group folds, fold-local normalization and PCA
fitting.reason: fixed ridge strength1 from prior H1 design, no posthoc grid exploration
fitting.scaler: observable max(std,0.1), remove exact constants; hidden PCA existing train-only standardizer
fitting.target: exact final failure, historical reference labels, outside feature construction
fitting.probabilities: no claim of independent calibration at this feasibility stage; raw logits used for threshold choice

policy: abort if failure score strictly above threshold; choose threshold on development OOF scores with at most3 discarded successful puzzles/1000 (0.3 pp loss target). Also report optimistic frontier allowing10/1000 success loss (1 pp). Neither frontier is independent evaluation.

success_candidate.cost: lower simultaneous confidence bound of relative complete cost saving >0.05 against fixed and best feasible observable comparator
success_candidate.resolution: lower simultaneous bound for per-input verified-resolution difference >-0.01
success_candidate.warning: these margins are practical design choices, not scientific norms; confirmatory sizing must assume true effects strictly inside the admissible region

gate: Before new corpus: validate parity and cleanup, measure real score and split/queue overhead, and assess zero-overhead optimistic saving. Do not launch independent confirmation if none of the internal candidates reaches plausible5 percent saving even against fixed continuation under the1 pp development loss allowance.

profiling.policy_timing_repeats: 3 if optimistic internal gate passes, otherwise 1 descriptive feasibility run
profiling.order: seeded randomized condition order, paired workload; warmup excluded
profiling.include: first9, transformations/score, KV slicing/packing, tail, final decoder, format/constraint/clue verifier; padding counted
profiling.not_a_benchmark_claim: shared local machine, timings descriptive with paired sensitivity, not inference speed guarantee

new_data: No intact prior evaluation exists for selecting this policy. Original unscored pilot32 is technical only. If gate passes, define new generator distribution, exclusion, precision/power, n and budget before its NCM outputs, then calibration/selection/evaluation separated.
limits: abort is abstention, not an early solved-grid return
all costs count including score-related decoders
cannot infer native metacognition from an external policy benefit
no changing5 percent/1pp margins after observed outcome to rescue signal
